reports.title: Nickajack 11/5/26 fishing report
reports.text:
The fishing has been great the past few weeks the bass are really starting to key in on bait making them pretty easy to track down and you can throw about whatever you want to catch them.
A lot of times you won’t actually see the fish schooling on the bait all that will be going on under the surface but you can for sure just track down moving bait balls and windblown banks and capitalize on some of these schools of bass if you don’t have a front looker on your back to search around for them
It’s firing good on the last little bit of good fall grass fishing we are going to have so you can still go out with the big rods and braid and lay a whooping down on some bass in the grass.

reports.title: Watts Bar Reservoir fishing report
reports.text:
Bass: Many anglers targeting any Black Bass species are finding better success in the lacustrine (Middle and Lower) areas of the reservoir. Anglers are finding more success in earlier morning hours using Texas rig, wacky rig, ned rigs, and topwater baits up shallow around woody debris or rocky structure. Once the sun gets high, many anglers convert to offshore fishing. Areas like offshore flats/humps and channel ledges are mostly targeted.

reports.title: Center Hill 10/29/26 fishing report
reports.text:
Bass Report – Quality Smallmouth & Topwater Action! We've been catching some very nice smallmouth bass on crankbaits in 25–30 feet of water! The topwater bite is also getting very good, providing some exciting action for anglers who enjoy watching bass explode on the surface. If you're looking for quality smallmouth or some exciting topwater action, Center Hill Lake is worth checking out!
Crappie Report – Giant Crappie Are Showing Up! We've recently caught some giant crappie around the 30-foot range, along with some smaller fish up shallow. It's always exciting to see those big slabs! With crappie being caught in different parts of the water column, there's an opportunity to target both…

reports.title: Kentucky Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Light winds teamed up with mild temperatures to provide excellent fishing conditions for bass and crappie anglers as October faded away and passed the torch on to November.
Crappie fishing has been good lately and some hefty stringers have been taken. Depths of 12 to 15 feet were producing but several anglers have reported success from the 9 to 12-foot range at times. Up Big Sandy and into West Sandy some crappie have been caught in 6-to-8-foot depths at times. However, the shallow bite has been slow to get going this fall as most fish are opting to hold out a bit deeper. A few cloudy rainy days would likely stimulate more crappie to move up to shallower depths as would lower surface temps…

reports.title: Cordell Hull fishing report
reports.text:
Bass- Fishing is decent. The water level has dropped a few feet, and most of the matted grass is just a few feet deep at the most. There are still some fishable mats, including the mats on the main channel around the mouth of Martin’s Creek. Some nice fish have been caught the last few days fishing the edge of the grass. Throwing a spinnerbait, topwater spook, swimbait, or something baitfish oriented on the sharp edges of the grass can produce a big bite if there is wind or baitfish in the grass. You can still get plenty of bites while fishing the main channel, rock banks with jigs or finesse baits if there is current on them.
